reviews.text:
While the rest of the app's interface and asset library function fine, the "Create New Voice" feature is completely bricked by a faulty backend validator.  
Even when uploading a video clip that strictly fits the required MP4/MOV formats, runs well within the 5 to 30-second window, and features completely clear speech with zero prolonged silence, the app repeatedly throws a false "Speaking duration is too short" error. The upload parser is fundamentally bugged and rejects completely valid files, rendering custom voice creation entirely impossible. Please fix this broken validation script ASAP!

reviews.title: Very Disappointing Experience
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Kling AI. After purchasing a subscription and spending considerable time creating detailed prompts, I have yet to produce a single usable video.

The platform repeatedly fails to follow instructions, generates unrealistic facial features and movements, changes character appearances, and misspells even clearly specified text. Despite providing detailed descriptions and reference images, the final videos consistently contain significant errors.

What makes this experience particularly frustrating is that users are charged credits for videos that fail to meet basic expectations. There is no reliable way to preview or correct these mistakes before additional credits are consumed. As a result, I have wasted valuable time, money, and subscription credits attempting to generate content that should have been straightforward.

I requested a full refund because none of the videos produced were usable.

For a paid AI video generation service, I expected significantly better accuracy, consistency, and quality. Until Kling AI improves its prompt adherence, video reliability, and credit policies, I cannot recommend this platform.

My overall experience has been frustrating, expensive, and extremely disappointing.

Initially, the platform offered me 60-second video generation, but that suddenly dropped to 30 seconds without any clear explanation.

While trying to adjust the generation settings, I accidentally pressed the Generate button multiple times. There was no confirmation prompt or option to cancel the generations once they started. As a result, I burned through over 1,000 credits on generations I never intended to submit.

The interface is confusing, the credit system is unforgiving, and the overall experience is extremely frustrating for a paying customer.

To make matters worse, canceling my subscription required navigating to their website rather than being able to complete the process directly in the app.

I’ve canceled my membership and contacted support requesting restoration of my credits.

For a paid service, I expected a much more user-friendly experience. I cannot recommend this app based on my experience.

reviews.title: Less reliable and increasingly frustrating
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Kling AI for quite some time, and unfortunately, instead of seeing improvements, the experience seems to be getting worse.
The platform is becoming increasingly expensive, yet the quality and reliability of the results are disappointing. Even with clear, detailed prompts, the AI frequently ignores basic instructions, changes things I specifically asked it to preserve, and produces results that are completely different from what I requested.
Every failed generation costs credits, meaning users end up paying repeatedly for the platform’s inability to follow instructions.
To make matters worse, new versions are advertised, but accessing or upgrading to them is far from straightforward.
I don’t mind paying for a good service, but I do mind paying more for increasingly unreliable results.
Higher costs should come with better performance, not more frustration.
At this point, Kling AI feels less like a creative tool and more like an expensive exercise in trial and error.
Very disappointing, especially for someone who has been using the platform for a while.

Title: NOT READY FOR PUBLIC RELEASE — WASTES MONEY, TIME AND CREATIVITY

★☆☆☆☆ — 1 Star

Kling AI is one of the most frustrating and disappointing creative applications I have ever used.

The app advertises free access, but when I attempted to generate videos, I was confronted with extraordinarily long waiting times — approximately two days — unless I paid to move ahead in the queue.

So I paid. Then I purchased additional credits, spending approximately $50 on tokens, only to discover that the real problem wasn’t waiting time. The software repeatedly failed to follow basic instructions.

My first video turned out well, which encouraged me to continue. Unfortunately, what followed was a succession of costly, frustrating failures.

Characters delivered dialogue assigned to other characters. Unrequested third and fourth characters appeared in scenes. One character began speaking Russian without being instructed to do so. Even when I explicitly requested NO DIALOGUE, the software generated speech and movements I never asked for.

These are not minor artistic imperfections. They are fundamental failures to follow instructions.

The software can produce impressive animation, which makes these failures even more frustrating. What good is realistic movement if the wrong character delivers the dialogue, unwanted characters appear, and simple instructions are ignored?

Every failed generation consumes credits. Every attempt to correct the software’s mistakes costs more money and more

reviews.title: ⭐ 1-Star Review: Beware of Kling AI – Missing Credits and Terrible Customer Service!
reviews.text:
I strongly recommend thinking twice before spending your money on Kling AI. My experience has been extremely frustrating, and I feel completely ripped off.

I initially purchased a $10 subscription and received 660 credits. When I needed more, I upgraded to the $37 plan, which advertised 3,000 credits. Instead of receiving the full 3,000 credits, I was only given approximately 2,300. On top of that, I earned free credits by posting on the app, and those credits were also shorted.

I submitted a support ticket and received a quick response initially, but there seemed to be a language barrier, and my issue was not properly understood or resolved. I submitted another ticket and received no response. After sending FOUR additional tickets, I am still being ignored.

This is unacceptable customer service, especially from a company that has no problem taking your money but fails to deliver the credits you paid for.

I have paid for credits I never received, earned rewards that were not fully credited, and wasted my time repeatedly trying to get help.

Save yourself the frustration and be cautious before purchasing anything from this app. Based on my experience, I would not recommend Kling AI to anyone. Worst customer service I’ve experienced in a long time!

reviews.title: They Deleted My Account and Content - 0 Customer Service
reviews.text:
After the app's recent update, I was forced to log in again. No big deal, right? I do this all the time after updates. Wrong; I was told I wasn't registered and needed to sign up and use the free version or subscribe.

Trying different login methods (biometrics) and following the FAQs didn't help. Uninstalling, restarting, and reinstalling didn't work. I reached out to customer service, but they were skeptical and asked for proof of membership and payment. I subscribed through my Apple account and have the full subscription and payment history.

I sent many screenshots showing the active subscription, Apple receipts for the monthly charges, and screenshots of any related subscriber emails. I sent all the requested evidence and more… crickets, just crickets. No word back from them. It was, and still is, a terrible way to treat your (previously) happily paying customers.

reviews.title: Misleading Credit Policy – Thousands of Paid Credits Disappeared Overnight
reviews.text:
I subscribed to Kling AI during the 10th Anniversary promotion specifically because the subscription clearly indicated that purchased credits would carry over. I paid real money for those credits and intentionally accumulated them for future projects.

Due to work commitments, I couldn’t use the credits immediately, so I cancelled the recurring subscription with the intention of resubscribing later while retaining the credits I had already paid for.

Yesterday morning, my account still had more than 4,000 credits. My subscription expired the same day. When I checked the next morning, almost all of those paid credits had disappeared, leaving me with only 86 credits.

If this is the intended behavior, then the marketing around “carry-over credits” is extremely misleading. Customers purchase credits believing they own them, not that they will silently disappear when a subscription ends.

This is not a small issue—it is a matter of customer trust. Thousands of credits purchased with real money should not vanish overnight without a clear warning and transparent explanation.

I will also be reporting this issue to Apple. Unless Kling restores my paid credits or provides a satisfactory explanation, I cannot recommend this service to anyone. AI tools are built on trust, and right now Kling has completely lost mine.

I would like to provide feedback regarding Kling video generation.

I am a paying customer and regularly generate story-based videos with recurring characters for content creation. My biggest concern is not generation speed or resolution, but consistency and usable output. Many generations contain significant errors that force me to discard large portions of the video, including:

* Character appearance changing during the clip.
* Objects changing size or position.
* Characters dropping items they were supposed to hold.
* Instructions being ignored despite being clearly stated.
* Unwanted actions being introduced into the scene.
* Inconsistent continuity between the starting and ending frames.

Because of these issues, I often have to trim away a large percentage of the generated footage. While I may pay for a 15-second generation, only a portion of that footage is usable in the final edit.

I also have concerns about branding and value. As a paying customer, I am effectively showcasing Kling-generated content to my audience whenever the Kling branding is visible on generated videos. The object no longer follows the reference video properly — the movements are inaccurate and often glitch. After a glitch happens, the animation completely loses the rhythm of the music and never gets back in sync.

I’ve already spent around 1000 credits trying to get a usable result, but most of the generated videos are simply unusable because of these issues. It feels like a waste of credits and time.

I hope the developers fix the Motion control function soon, because right now it’s extremely unreliable.

reviews.title: Scammers Kling ai
reviews.text:
Hello everyone,
I used the Kling AI service for a short time, but unfortunately my experience was extremely negative.

First of all, the subscription is very expensive. I paid a large amount for just one month of access.

The biggest issue started when I decided to cancel my subscription. Even after I canceled it properly, Kling AI continued trying to charge my card for the next month.

To make things worse, I completely deleted my account, but the service still keeps attempting to withdraw money from my card, even though I no longer have an active subscription or even an account.

I also tried contacting customer support multiple times, but they never replied. The customer service is basically nonexistent.

Because of these aggressive billing attempts and zero support, I am giving Kling AI 1 star and I do not recommend this service to anyone.
